settings.hero_desc: A finely detailed scale model of the Prophet's Mosque in Madinah - the iconic green dome, rows of silver domes and arched arcades reproduced with care. A meaningful centrepiece and gift for institutions, donors and collectors.
settings.perso_placeholder: Your scale, finish, base and dedication plaque
settings.s1_body: We recreate revered Islamic architecture as detailed scale models, built with respect and precision. This model of the Prophet's Mosque captures its defining features - the green dome, the field of silver domes and the arched arcades along its walls. A deeply meaningful centrepiece for mosques, institutions and homes, and a profound gift for donors, dignitaries and loved ones.
settings.case_body: Commissioned as art installation in Saudi Railway, this model of the Masjid e-Nabawi Mosque carried real significance for its recipient - the sacred landmark recreated with care, presented as a keepsake to be treasured for years.
settings.case_quote: It moved everyone who saw it. A beautiful, respectful tribute to a place so dear to us.
settings.prov_p: Recreating a sacred place is a responsibility we take seriously - every dome, arch and detail rendered faithfully, so the model honours the landmark it represents.
